newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil 1996 net turns to profit.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil 1996 net turns to profit.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Oil Refinery Co, an unlisted unit of the Hyundai Group, said on Thursday it posted a net profit of 23 billion won last year versus 48 billion won loss in 1995.
It is the company's first annual profit since it took over the debt-ridden Kukdong Oil in 1993, a company spokesman said.
"We were able to post profit thanks to a sharply reduced depreciation cost and a rise in domestic sales and exports following capacity expansion," he said.
Hyundai almost tripled its oil refining capacity last May to 310,000 barrels per day (bpd) from 110,000 bpd with the addition of a new crude distillation unit.
He said its turnover rose to 2.48 trillion won in 1996 from 1.15 trillion in 1995.
